label: Animation
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce and/or sell art made with a method in which figures are manipulated to appear as moving images.

label: Apparel and Fashion
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that design, manufacture, and distribute clothing and apparel.

label: Arts and Crafts
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that participate in economic activities related to the creation of goods by artisans or skilled craftspeople or the design, development, manufacturing, and distribution of craft supplies.

label: Automotive
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that participate in the design, development, manufacturing, marketing, and selling of motor vehicles.

label: Aviation & Aerospace
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that engage in the research, development, manufacture and sale of flight vehicles, major flight-vehicle subsystems such as propulsion and avionics and key support systems necessary for the testing, operation, and maintenance of flight vehicles.

label: Biotechnology
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that use living organisms and molecular biology to produce healthcare-related products.

label: Building Materials
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce and/or sell building materials, such as lumber, plywood, millwork, and wood panels; brick, stone, and related construction materials; roofing, siding, and insulation materials; and other construction materials, including manufactured homes (such as mobile homes) and/or prefabricated buildings.

label: Business Supplies and Equipment
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce and/or sell consumables and equipment regularly used in offices by businesses and other organizations.

label: Commercial Real Estate
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that manage, construct, design, or sell real estate (buildings or land) intended to generate a profit, either from capital gains or rental income.

label: Computer Hardware
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce and/or sell the physical parts of a computer, such as the case, central processing unit (CPU), random access memory (RAM), monitor, mouse, keyboard, computer data storage, graphics card, sound card, speakers and motherboard.

label: Computer Networking
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce, sell, and/or provide services for interconnected computing devices that can exchange data and share resources with each other.

label: Consumer Electronics
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce and/or sell electronic equipment intended for everyday use.

label: Consumer Goods
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce and/or sell final products ready for use by the consumer.

label: Cosmetics
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that manufacture and distribute cosmetic products, such as foundation, mascara, skincare, haircare and soap.

label: Dairy
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce and/or sell dairy products made from raw milk, processed milk, and dairy substitutes.

label: Defense & Space
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce and/or sell guided missiles and space vehicles.

label: Design
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that create plans or specifications for the production of an object or system, or for the implementation of an activity or process or the result of that plan or specification in the form of a prototype, product, or process.

label: E-Learning
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that use a combination of computer hardware, software, and educational theory and practice to facilitate learning.

label: Education Management
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that participate in activities related to educational leadership and management.

label: Entertainment
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that are involved in the production and distribution of mass media entertainment.

label: Fine Art
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce and/or sell products related to the visual arts such as painting, drawing, printmaking, sculpture, ceramics, and photography.

label: Food & Beverages
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that prepare, present and serve food and beverages to customers.

label: Food Production
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that transform livestock and agricultural products into products for intermediate or final consumption.

label: Furniture
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that participate in the design, manufacture, distribution, and sale of household furniture (such as baby furniture, box springs, and mattresses) and outdoor furniture; office furniture (except those sold in combination with office supplies and equipment), and other furniture objects.

label: Government Relations
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that monitor and engage in the federal and state legislative process, facilitate relationships with members of local, state, and federal administrative agencies, departments, commissions, and boards; and engage in grassroots lobbying and legislative policy strategies.

label: Health, Wellness and Fitness
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce and deliver products and services that promote physical and mental wellbeing.

label: Human Resources
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that are involved in finding, screening, recruiting, and training job applicants, as well as administering benefits

label: Import and Export
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that participate in international trade and exchange of goods, products and services.

label: Industrial Automation
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce and/or sell autonomous control systems that use technologies such as robotics and computer software to handle processes and machinery.

label: Information Technology and Services
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that provide functions, maintenance, and support for information technology products, or provide services that support the design, development, application, implementation, support, and management of computer-based information systems.

label: Leisure, Travel & Tourism
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that participate in business focused on recreation, entertainment, sports, and tourism-related products and services; and in the business of attracting, accommodating, and entertaining tourists, and the business of operating tours.

label: Luxury Goods and Jewelry
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce and/or sell goods that are not necessary but deemed highly desirable within a culture or society, such as haute couture apparel, fine jewelry and watches, and high-end luggage.

label: Maritime
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that participate in the construction, repair, and scraping of watercraft, as well as the movement of cargo and other materials.

label: Mechanical or Industrial Engineering
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that conduct engineering projects that combine engineering physics and mathematics principles with materials science, to design, analyze, manufacture, and maintain mechanical or industrial systems.

label: Medical Devices
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce and distribute instruments, apparatus, implements, machines, contrivances, implants, in vitro reagents, or other similar products which are intended for use in the diagnosis, mitigation or treatment of disease or other medical conditions.

label: Music
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that are involved in music creation, performance, and distribution.

label: Non-profit Organization Management
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that participate in the administration and management of a not-for-profit organization.

label: Online Media
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce and/or distribute media, which is published over the Internet, and includes, without limitation, web-sites, blogs, and social media.

label: Outsourcing/Offshoring
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that negotiate contracts with a third party to perform a specific function and/or send in-house jobs to be performed in another country/region.

label: Packaging and Containers
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that carry out the planning, creating, manufacturing, wrapping, boxing, or bottling of goods.

label: Paper and Forest Products
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce and/or sell any material derived from forestry for direct consumption or commercial use, such as lumber, paper, or fodder for livestock.

label: Philanthropy
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that participate in charitable giving, for the public good, focusing on quality of life.

label: Program Development
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that participate in the ongoing systematic process of planning, implementing and evaluating programs.

label: Public Policy
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that participate in programs as a course of action created and/or enacted, typically by a government or nonprofit organization, in response to social issues.

label: Renewables & Environment
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that are part of the energy industry focused on new and appropriate renewable energy technologies.

label: Research
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that provide systematic investigation into and study of materials and sources in order to establish facts and reach new conclusions.

label: Semiconductors
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce and/or sell semiconductors.

label: Sporting Goods
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce and/or sell the equipment, materials, apparel, and gear used to participate in a sport.

label: Tobacco
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce and/or sell tobacco and tobacco-related products

label: Transportation/Trucking/Railroad
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that provide services for moving people, goods, or the infrastructure to do so.

label: Veterinary
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that participate in economic activities related to the practice of veterinary medicine, dentistry, or surgery for animals.

label: Warehousing
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that provide storage of physical inventory for sale or distribution.

label: Wine and Spirits
hierarchy: This industry includes entities that produce and/or sell alcoholic drinks exclusive of beer and cider.
